P.name: Shurima's Legacy
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever a {{tip|turret}} outside the enemy team's base is destroyed, a marker is placed above its ruins which can be targeted by '''Azir'''.
P.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Disc of the Sun:}} '''Azir''' can select a marker to construct the {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} above the ruins after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]]. The {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} will activate after being assembled over 5 seconds.

'''''Azir''' cannot construct a {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} with the marker while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
P.description3: The {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}} functions the same as a standard [[Turret#Inner_turret|inner turret]] but deals {{as|magic damage}}, gains {{as|40% AP}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, and grants its kill credit to '''Azir'''. The {{as|Sun Disc's|buzzword2}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}} decays over 45 seconds and loses {{sti|armor|{{as|100 armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|100 magic resistance}}}} while '''Azir''' is not alive or is too far away.
P.description4: ''See [[Azir#Pets|Pets]] for more details about the {{as|Sun Disc|buzzword2}}.''

Q.name: Conquering Sands
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' orders all {{as|Sand Soldiers|buzzword2}} to dash toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through as well as those in front of them upon arrival, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 25% for 1 second.
Q.description2: Enemies hit by subsequent soldiers take no additional damage or {{tip|slow}}.
Q.description3: ''A summoned {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} is required to cast this ability.''

W.name: Arise!
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' summons a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} at the target location that is {{tip|untargetable}}, lasts 10 seconds, and grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. The {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} expires twice as fast while within range of an enemy {{tip|turret}}, and does so instantly if '''Azir''' is too far away.

'''Azir''' periodically [[stock]]s a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}}, up to a maximum of 2.
W.description2: When '''Azir''' declares a basic attack against an enemy in a soldier's {{sti|attack range}}, the {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} attacks in his stead, thrusting their spear in the target's direction to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck in a line. Against the primary target, the {{as|Sand Soldier's|buzzword2}} attack applies both {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, the damage of which is reduced to 50% effectiveness. Targets hit beyond the closest take {{pp|20; then +8*x for 10|1;9 to 18|formula=20% at level 1, then +8% per level starting at level 9 and capped at level 18|key=%}}<!--stops at 18--> damage. Subsequent {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} attacks against the same target deal 25% damage without applying {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
W.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{pplevel|0; then +8*x|1;10+(x-1)|formula=0 at level 1, then +8 per level starting at level 10}} (+ {{ap|50 to 110}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|35 to 65}}% AP)}}}}

E.name: Shifting Sands
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|dashes}} to the {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} closest to the cursor, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within his path.
E.leveling:
{{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
E.description2: If '''Azir''' dashes into an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he stops and gains a charge of ''{{ai|Arise!|Azir}}''.
E.description3: ''A summoned {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} is required to cast this ability. '''Azir''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.''

R.name: Emperor's Divide
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' calls forth a phalanx of soldiers from {{tt|175|See notes}} units behind him, catching enemies from up to {{tt|325|See notes}} units behind him and charging forward {{tt|575|See notes}} units in the target direction.
R.leveling: {{st|Width|{{ap|6 to 8}} soldiers|Width (charge)|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{ap|620 to 820}}|Width (impassable wall)|{{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{ap|750 to 950}}}}
R.description2: Enemies impacted by the charge are dealt {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocked away}} over 1 second to a line 650 units in front of '''Azir'''.
R.description3: Upon finishing their charge, the soldiers stand as a wall for 5 seconds, acting as impassible terrain against enemies and granting {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings. '''Azir''' and his allies can move through these soldiers.
